selection_rule: Pre-existing fixed16 plus eight evenly spaced training-order positions; no score-based selection

cases.caption: A thin piece of wood is bent into a bow shape, exhibiting its flexibility.
A plastic ruler is bent until it cracks, displaying a visible stress fracture that propagates.
A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
A construction worker uses a suction cup to lift a heavy glass panel with a small picture adhered to it; the picture remains affixed.
A person mops up a puddle of water on a concrete floor, the water disappearing as the mop passes.
A person uses a pair of pliers to open a stubborn metal bottle, bending the cap slightly in the process.
A rower pulls an oar from the water, the blade dripping water back into the lake. .
A scientist uses a probe to nudge a small, delicate insect on a leaf, causing it to twitch minimally.
A unicycle wheel rolls over a small curb; the rider adjusts their position to keep upright.
A bulldozer pulls a heavy load attached with a chain, moving it across the ground.
A speeding car crashes into a brick wall, crumpling the front end and stopping abruptly.
A large, orange plastic egg is rolled up a plastic slide, then rolls down, ending at the bottom.
Two people stretch a bungee cord, extending it to its maximum length.
Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
A large, clear balloon is inflated with air, showing the internal pressure causing the balloon to stretch.
A paint roller, dipped in green paint, is used to cover a section of a metal fence, creating a uniform green coat.

The video captures a wide desert scrubland beneath a towering, dark storm cloud that dominates the sky. A broad gray column of rain or outflow descends from the cloud base near the center-left and touches the flat ground. Its lower portion is lit by a bright sunlit patch that persists. Along the right horizon, a low mountain range stands partly veiled by a tan dust band that thickens and rises toward the ridgeline. This dust front advances steadily leftward along the ground, spreading toward the center and increasingly obscuring the mountains. The base of the central column blends with the rising dust near the horizon, while the dark shelf overhead shifts subtly. The foreground shrubs and the camera viewpoint appear fixed, framing an ongoing storm process.

In an open grassy clearing, a man in a dark green leather jacket stands at the left of the frame, his right eye swollen and bruised, gaze fixed right. A vertical pole marks the right edge. A second man, in a light gray jacket stained red across the chest and a small bandage on his forehead, steps into view from the right and faces him. The two hold their positions, looking at one another against the tall green grass.

The man in the leather jacket raises a clenched hand to his mouth and nose, holding it there for several moments before lowering it again. He then turns and moves across the foreground, his back and head growing larger until they partly block the second man from view. As this happens, the man in the gray jacket lifts one arm toward a green mesh structure at the lower left. The framing shifts throughout, the right-edge pole sliding out of view while the grassy background pans slowly behind the two figures.

The video showcases an indoor rug-cleaning workshop where a rectangular, shaggy beige rug lies partly saturated with white soapy foam on a large white tarp. A person wearing white rubber boots and dark trousers stands at the far end of the rug, gripping a long-handled tool with a flat metal head. Throughout the excerpt the metal head stays at the rug's far edge, drifting slowly leftward rather than traveling down the rug's length toward the camera, while the operator's boots remain roughly in place. A mound of white suds gathers and grows at the head as the operator works it, and the long handle tilts from nearly vertical to a more diagonal angle. The rug's body keeps its mottled beige-and-foam pattern, with the foamy region ahead of the head unchanged. A pool of foam and water fills the foreground below the rug, showing only minor surface ripples. A blue air-mover fan, cleaning machines, bottles and a red cone stay fixed in the background. The camera remains static, capturing this ongoing agitation at the rug's far edge without showing how it began or where it ends.

The video captures a tranquil daytime landscape dominated by a still, glassy pond that fills the lower half of the frame and mirrors the surrounding scenery. Across the water lies a grassy bank where a small cluster of red-roofed buildings sits nestled at the foot of densely forested green hills. A rounded, tree-covered hill rises on the right, while a steep wooded slope occupies the left side of the view. Above stretches a pale blue sky streaked with thin, wispy clouds. Throughout the excerpt, the composition holds steady, with the village, hills, and sky keeping the same positions and relative arrangement. The water surface remains calm and mirror-like, reflecting the hills and the red-roofed buildings in a stable, quiet state. The scene simply persists in its tranquil, reflective atmosphere.

The video captures a calm sea meeting a sandy beach under a low sun right of center near the horizon. A bright golden reflection column runs from the sun down the water and onto the wet, glistening foreground sand. Small waves roll toward the shore, their dark crests and white foam shifting across the mid-water and wet sand edge. The sun's glittering reflection on the water shimmers and changes texture continuously as the ripples move. The bright patch reflected on the wet sand also flickers in shape and intensity. The thin foam edge left by the wash moves slightly inward and outward. The horizon, sun, and cloud layout remain constant, consistent with a stationary camera. Scattered small pebbles and shallow depressions dot the foreground sand throughout the visible motion.

The video captures a night scene over a calm body of water, with a low, lit city skyline stretching across the horizon. A volley of firework bursts occupies the upper-middle sky: one large spherical burst on the right, a horizontal row of smaller gold bursts to its left, and a couple of tiny points above the row. The water mirrors the bright bursts and the skyline lights. The camera framing stays fixed throughout. The large right-hand burst, already expanded, holds its position while its hue drifts between greenish-white and pink/red as its dots fade. The tiny points above the row grow into several new pink and red spherical bursts that expand in place rather than translating, while the gold row holds its line, its dots twinkling before dimming as the upper bursts brighten. Thin near-vertical streaks then appear and lengthen beneath several bursts as the spheres dissolve into separated, twinkling dots. The reflections on the water track these changes, jittering with small ripples.

The video captures a wide, calm body of water at dusk or dawn, with a low tree-lined shore crossing the middle of the frame. A warm orange-yellow glow sits at the left horizon beneath a pale blue-grey sky streaked with thin scattered clouds. The calm water mirrors this light and the dark treeline, while small ripples continuously wobble, stretch, and reshape the reflected bands across the surface. Bright reflection patches shift only in shape against the fixed horizon, while tiny pale specks along the far shoreline remain at fixed positions, showing gentle surface motion rather than any moving vessel or person.

The video captures a close-up of a moss-covered stone spout protruding from the right, already discharging a continuous clear stream of water that falls into a dark pool below. The falling column holds its position while its surface texture and edges flicker with turbulence, the flow unbroken throughout. At the impact point, a bright patch of white foam shifts shape and intensity, sending scattered bubbles across the pool surface. Concentric ripples spread outward from the splash, and a vertical shimmering reflection of the column wavers and breaks up on the water. A thin secondary sheet of water runs off the top and right of the structure, shimmering slightly as it descends. The spout, the out-of-focus dried straw and earth in the background, and the overall framing hold steady. The discharge continues evenly, the flowing water and disturbed pool surface carrying the visible motion.
